author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Satelital, a rule-discovery puzzle game where you place alien symbols on a grid. Uncover their logic as you journey through an atmospheric solar system. Satelital will be available late 2026 on PC (Steam).
title: Satelital - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the accolades trailer for Swan Song, the upcoming cozy and emotional puzzle game where music guides your journey. In Swan Song, use notes of different shapes and sizes to program a music box and solve each puzzle. Help the swan reach the exit as you uncover a touching story of family, loss and grief. Swan Song is available now on PC (Steam).
title: Swan Song - Official Accolades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest trailer for Unseen: Someone, an episodic psychological horror game developed by 
VladisLive Dev. Michael is a 14-year-old living an ordinary life as a game developer. He usually preferred working at night because he felt a calm, special atmosphere then. Yet, at one point, he needed to leave the room... but leaving the room at night was a mistake. Unseen: Someone will be available on PC (Steam), with a Demo available now.
title: Unseen - Someone - Official Trailer 2

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the release date trailer for Waterpark Simulator, a first-person game where you build and run your own waterpark. You'll design the slides, manage your employees, and ultimately customize and grow your park. Waterpark Simulator is launching July 31, 2026 on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Waterpark Simulator - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest trailer for BLEACH Mirrors High showcasing combat and customization gameplay.

Set after the events of the Thousand-Year Blood War, BLEACH Mirrors High delivers an original story packed with 13 Court Guard Squads action.
title: BLEACH Mirrors High - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer
